name: domain.hf_datasets
description: Hugging Face Datasets engine: PyArrow zero-copy tables, lazy streaming iterables, lakehouse conversion, and schema profiling

entrypoints.name: hf_inspect_dataset
entrypoints.description: Inspect dataset splits, features, row counts, and metadata without full data pull

parameters.name: path_or_name
parameters.description: Dataset identifier, HuggingFace hub name, or local directory/file path

parameters.name: split
parameters.description: Specific split to inspect (e.g. train, test, validation)

entrypoints.name: hf_evaluate_storage_strategy
entrypoints.description: Evaluate dataset footprint and select between memory-mapped Arrow and streaming iterators

parameters.name: auto_stream_threshold_mb
parameters.description: Threshold in megabytes to trigger streaming mode

entrypoints.name: hf_stream_sample
entrypoints.description: Lazily sample N records from a streaming dataset iterator without downloading full dataset

parameters.name: max_samples
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to sample

entrypoints.name: hf_profile_schema
entrypoints.description: Extract detailed column schemas, Arrow types, nullability, and sample values

entrypoints.name: hf_transform_dataset
entrypoints.description: Execute lazy filtering, column projection, and batch transformation

parameters.name: filter_op
parameters.description: Filter operator (eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, in)

entrypoints.name: hf_convert_format
entrypoints.description: Convert dataset file between CSV, JSON, Arrow, and Parquet lakehouse formats

parameters.name: target_format
parameters.description: Target format: parquet, arrow, json, or csv

entrypoints.name: hf_commit_to_vault
entrypoints.description: Commit dataset catalog and schema provenance to Knowledge Vault (Rule 40)

parameters.name: input_path
parameters.description: Source dataset file or directory path
